subject.title: Disable Chrome OptGuide/WasmTts model downloads in headless/server mode

question: Should OpenClaw add OptimizationGuide/WasmTts disabled-feature flags by default for managed and sandbox headless Chrome launches, or keep this as an operator-controlled `browser.extraArgs` and custom-entrypoint workaround?
rationale: The code change is small, but default Chromium launch behavior is product policy and the flag contract is version-sensitive; the existing workaround covers only local managed profiles and does not settle sandbox defaults.

options.title: Prove, Then Add Headless Defaults
options.body: Run live Chrome proof, then add the selected disabled-feature list to managed and sandbox headless launches with focused launch-arg tests and docs.

options.title: Document Operator Control Only
options.body: Keep defaults unchanged and document `browser.extraArgs` for local managed profiles plus custom sandbox entrypoints as the supported server-mode mitigation.

options.title: Add A Dedicated Config Knob
options.body: Introduce a narrow suppression option only if maintainers decide the existing config surface is insufficient despite the repo's high bar for new config.

recommendation.title: Prove, Then Add Headless Defaults
recommendation.body: Run live Chrome proof, then add the selected disabled-feature list to managed and sandbox headless launches with focused launch-arg tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-history signal for the browser launch path and already reviewed the stale linked implementation PR.
